{{Quote|They tricked me. We were never meant to win this war. They used me and my people to test the Republic's strength.''"<br />"''Who used you?''"<br />"''The Sith.|Mandalore the Ultimate tells Revan of the Sith's involvement in the Mandalorian Wars|<ref name="Revan" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] [[Sith/Legends|member]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] served as a '''Sith emissary''' in the [[Time/Legends|time]] before the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Around [[3978 BBY]], the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] sent the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] as an [[Diplomat/Legends|emissary]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] in order to [[Qâzoi Kyantuska|convince]] [[Mandalore the Ultimate]] to help in the [[Search for Dramath the Second's remains|search]] for the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Dramath the Second|half-brother's]] [[Dramath the Second's tomb|tomb]]. Mandalore helped the Sith find the tomb, and the emissary told Mandalore about the [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] that his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] had of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]' rise and their defeat of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|About two years before he declared war on the Republic, Mandalore was approached by a man with skin the color of blood&mdash;a Sith. [...] But this red-skinned being came to Mandalore. He claimed to be the emissary of a powerful Master&mdash;a descendant of the Sith Lord who had driven Dramath into exile&mdash;and convinced Mandalore to help him search for his enemy's tomb.|Revan tells Canderous Ordo of the emissary|<ref name="Revan" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who achieved the rank of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> lived in the [[Time/Legends|time]] prior to the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Around [[3978 BBY]], he was chosen by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] to act as his [[Emissary/Legends|emissary]] to the current [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]], [[Mandalore the Ultimate]], the leader of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors. He was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] and managed to [[Qâzoi Kyantuska|convince]] Mandalore to help in his [[Search for Dramath the Second's remains|search]] for the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Dramath the Second|half-brother's]] [[Dramath the Second's tomb|tomb]]. After Mandalore helped the Sith find the tomb on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rekkiad]], the emissary retrieved the [[Skeleton/Legends|remains]] to bring back to the Emperor. He then told Mandalore of the [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] had seen of the Mandalorians rising up and defeating the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He told Mandalore of how his Master saw the Mandalorians conquering many worlds, and of how they would crush the Republic until it collapsed on itself, promising Mandalore a glorious victory.<ref name="Revan" />

[[3976 BBY|Two years later]], the Mandalorians went on to invade the Republic, crushing countless worlds in the process, until in [[3963 BBY]] the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and his [[Revanchist|faction]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] joined the war. They were able to turn the tide, and Revan [[Battle of Malachor V|personally defeated]] Mandalore in combat. Only as Mandalore lay [[Death/Legends|dying]] did he realize that he and his people were betrayed by the Sith and the emissary they sent, and that they were never meant to win the war but to test the Republic's strength. His final words to Revan were of the Sith's involvement, and he told Revan where he could find proof of their existence.<ref name="Revan" />

==Personality and traits==
The Sith emissary was a Sith Pureblood male with [[Color/Legends|red]] skin. He was persuasive and manipulative enough to convince Mandalore the Ultimate to help him in his search. He was also able to persuasively convince Mandalore to invade the Republic, with the help of his [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]].<ref name="Revan" />

==Powers and abilities==
The Sith emissary was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. He was a Sith Lord<ref name="TERC" /> of the Sith Empire who was advanced enough in the use of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] to [[Qâzoi Kyantuska|manipulate Mandalore's mind]]. He was so powerful in the art that the spell was only broken when Mandalore was fatally wounded.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith emissary was first mentioned in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''.<ref name="Revan" />
